name: EngBrain synthetic demonstration corpus
notice: These scenarios are authored for a deterministic demo. They are not a public-issue benchmark and must not be reported as one.

targets.title: PostgreSQL connection pool exhausted
targets.problem: SQLAlchemy requests timed out after every pooled database connection was checked out. Raising the request timeout only hid the exhaustion; capping concurrent workers and sizing the pool resolved it.

queries.lexical: SQLAlchemy pool timeout all connections checked out
queries.paraphrase: Every database worker is waiting because the reusable sessions are occupied

targets.title: Pinned HTTP client fixed certificate verification in CI
targets.problem: A transitive urllib3 upgrade changed certificate handling and CI started rejecting the intermediate certificate chain. Pinning the last known-good client dependency restored verification until the CA bundle could be updated.

queries.lexical: urllib3 pin certificate verification CI chain
queries.paraphrase: Secure requests began rejecting a trusted server after a package refresh

targets.title: Compose variable was empty inside the container
targets.problem: The application read DATABASE_URL as empty even though it existed in the developer shell. Docker Compose did not interpolate the expected env file; declaring env_file and the variable mapping fixed the container configuration.

queries.paraphrase: The container cannot see the endpoint that works in the host terminal

targets.title: SQLite writer lock under parallel workers
targets.problem: Concurrent test workers raised database is locked while writing. Long transactions held the SQLite writer lock; keeping writes short and enabling a bounded busy timeout removed the intermittent failures.

queries.lexical: SQLite database is locked concurrent writers busy timeout
queries.paraphrase: Parallel jobs collide while saving state to the local file database

targets.title: Synchronous network call blocked the async event loop
targets.problem: An async endpoint stopped serving unrelated requests during a slow HTTP call because a synchronous client ran on the event loop. Switching to the async client restored concurrency.

queries.lexical: async event loop blocked synchronous HTTP client
queries.paraphrase: One slow outbound request freezes other handlers in the server

targets.title: Pytest could not import the src layout package
targets.problem: Pytest reported ModuleNotFoundError for the application package because the src layout was not installed in the environment. Installing the project in editable mode and declaring package discovery fixed imports.

queries.lexical: pytest ModuleNotFoundError src layout editable install
queries.paraphrase: The test runner cannot locate our library even though its files are present

targets.title: Windows hook command was parsed as a string
targets.problem: A Claude Code hook printed its quoted executable path instead of launching it under PowerShell. Using an executable command with a separate args array fixed process startup.

queries.lexical: Windows PowerShell hook quoted executable args
queries.paraphrase: The automation shows the command text but never starts the program

targets.title: Authentication middleware rejected CORS preflight
targets.problem: The browser received 401 for an OPTIONS preflight because authentication middleware ran before CORS handling. Allowing preflight through the CORS layer resolved the cross-origin request failure.

queries.paraphrase: A browser blocks the cross-site call before it sends the actual request

targets.title: Queue message was acknowledged before persistence
targets.problem: Messages disappeared after worker crashes because the queue acknowledged delivery before the database transaction committed. Moving the acknowledgement after durable persistence stopped the data loss.

queries.lexical: queue ack before database commit lost messages
queries.paraphrase: A crashed consumer silently drops work that was not saved

targets.title: Naive local timestamp shifted daily reports
targets.problem: Daily reports moved rows across dates because a naive local datetime was interpreted as UTC in production. Storing timezone-aware UTC timestamps and converting only at display time fixed the boundary issue.

queries.lexical: naive datetime UTC daily report timezone shift
queries.paraphrase: Records appear on the previous day after deployment to a different region

targets.title: Migration failed when a column already existed
targets.problem: A deployment retry stopped at duplicate column because the migration was not safe to run twice. Checking the schema before applying the change made the rollout idempotent.

queries.paraphrase: A second rollout attempt fails because the first one partly completed

targets.title: Cached file result survived a source rewrite
targets.problem: The local index returned obsolete content after a file was rewritten because the cache key used only the path. Including the file modification fingerprint invalidated the cached result.

queries.lexical: cache stale file rewrite path fingerprint
queries.paraphrase: Search keeps showing yesterday's contents after the source was replaced

distractors.title: Database connection retry backoff
distractors.problem: A short jittered backoff prevents a burst of retries when PostgreSQL returns a transient network error.

distractors.title: Pool idle connections after deploy
distractors.problem: Reducing idle lifetime removes server-side connections left behind by old application workers.

distractors.title: Database socket file permission
distractors.problem: The local service account could not open the database socket because its directory permissions were too restrictive.

distractors.title: Rotate the database password
distractors.problem: The deployment secret changed but the connection string in the worker environment was not refreshed.

distractors.title: CA bundle missing in slim image
distractors.problem: The minimal container image omitted the operating system CA certificates needed for outbound HTTPS.

distractors.title: Certificate expires in staging
distractors.problem: The staging server served an expired leaf certificate and failed the browser trust check.

distractors.title: TLS minimum version mismatch
distractors.problem: The old test appliance only negotiated TLS 1.0 while the client required TLS 1.2.

distractors.title: Compose service DNS alias
distractors.problem: A container used localhost instead of the Compose service name when connecting to Redis.

distractors.title: Docker image copied wrong config
distractors.problem: The Docker build copied the development settings file over the production configuration.

distractors.title: Container port was not published
distractors.problem: The application listened on port 8080 inside Docker, but the host port mapping was missing.

distractors.title: SQLite read transaction lasted too long
distractors.problem: A cursor remained open while rendering a report, delaying a writer in another thread.

distractors.title: SQLite journal mode on network drive
distractors.problem: WAL mode behaved poorly on a shared network filesystem and was replaced with a local volume.

distractors.title: Unique index migration locked table
distractors.problem: Building a new unique index took long enough to block writes during deployment.

distractors.title: Async task leaked after request
distractors.problem: A background coroutine was never awaited and logged an exception after the response completed.

distractors.title: Async timeout cancelled child request
distractors.problem: The parent timeout cancelled a child task that was expected to finish its cleanup handler.

distractors.title: Thread pool saturated by file reads
distractors.problem: Large synchronous file reads filled the worker pool and delayed lightweight API handlers.

distractors.title: Pytest fixture scope mismatch
distractors.problem: A module-scoped fixture depended on a function-scoped database fixture and failed setup.

distractors.title: Pytest did not collect integration tests
distractors.problem: The test filename did not match the configured collection pattern, so CI skipped the suite.

distractors.title: Import collision with local module
distractors.problem: A project file named json.py shadowed the Python standard library during test startup.

distractors.title: PowerShell path contains spaces
distractors.problem: A script split a Windows executable path at spaces because the path was not passed as one argument.

distractors.title: Shell script used CRLF line endings
distractors.problem: Git Bash reported a bad interpreter because the script had Windows line endings.

distractors.title: Environment variable name typo
distractors.problem: The worker looked up CACHE_URL while the deployment manifest set REDIS_URL.

distractors.title: CORS origin missing scheme
distractors.problem: The allowlist used a hostname without the https scheme and did not match the browser origin.

distractors.title: CORS credentials wildcard rejected
distractors.problem: The browser refused credentialed requests because the server returned a wildcard origin.

distractors.title: Queue visibility timeout too short
distractors.problem: A long-running job was delivered twice after its visibility timeout expired.

distractors.title: Queue poison message retry loop
distractors.problem: A malformed message exhausted worker capacity because it was retried without a dead-letter policy.

distractors.title: Consumer committed offset too early
distractors.problem: The stream offset advanced before the batch finished, skipping rows after a process crash.

distractors.title: UTC display used wrong locale
distractors.problem: A report rendered UTC timestamps without converting them to the user's selected locale.

distractors.title: Daylight saving time duplicated hour
distractors.problem: A local-time aggregation counted the repeated clock hour twice during the autumn transition.

distractors.title: Cache key omitted tenant identifier
distractors.problem: Two customers shared a cache entry because the tenant ID was not included in the key.
